title: MZ Help with simple item notification

posts.author: thewowcollector
posts.body:
Hello all! I haven't been back here since we competed in the 2015 RPG Maker contest. I am hoping for a little help. I just bought RPG Maker MZ, and I was looking for a way to show in the top of my window when a player is given an item based on dialogue choices.
I know I can create a text message that tells them, but I swore I saw a plugin that would alert players at the top of the screen.
In game, players click on an item. They get a choice of either item 1 or item 2. I would like them notified at the top of the screen, rather then in a dialogue box. If this is built in, a screen shot would be amazing. Any advice I would greatly appreciate.
Thank you.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: Did you try and google like 'RPG Maker Item Notification plugin' or something? It would help if you showed an example pic of what you're after. I think all RPG Maker MZ projects include the 'text picture' plugin, where you can show text as a pic on screen.

posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
RPG Maker MZ ships with some plugins. Based on what you've said, check out:
<RPG Maker MZ install folder>/dlc/BasicResources/plugins/launch/
TinyGetInfoWndMZ
.js
(These plugins might be a separate download if you're not using the Steam version.)

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body: You could use Casper Gaming Toast Manager or Aerosys Gab Windows

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
This was free
[CGMZ] Toast Manager
This plugin creates up to 3 toast windows in each scene (some exceptions) which will display brief information or images to the player for a short amount of time. Windows will be shown as they are freed in the case of a queue of more than 3 toasts.
www.caspergaming.com

posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
For TinyGetInfoWndMZ to automatically trigger on gaining/losing items/gold via event commands, the switch defined by the plugin's
Event Command Switch
parameter needs to be turned on.
But yea, Siro's looks notably different. Like Aqua says, you may want to check out Casper's plugin, although I'm not sure whether that one automatically procs on gaining items/gold.
